newsitem.title: USA: ARIAD says reaches Hoechst milestone.
newsitem.headline: ARIAD says reaches Hoechst milestone.

text.p: ARIAD Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Monday it received the first milestone in its bone disease collaboration with Hoechst Marion Roussel Inc, a unit of Hoechst AG.
Under the terms of the pact, ARIAD will receive a $2 million cash payment within 30 days of reaching the milestone.
ARIAD and Hoechst Marion Roussel began to collaborate on the discovery and development of drugs to treat osteoporosis and related bone diseases in November 1995.
Hoechst Marion Roussel made an upfront cash payment to ARIAD of $10 million.
The agreement also calls for Hoechst Marion Roussel to provide research funding to ARIAD of up to $20 million over a five-year period and up to $10 million in research milestone payments.
